results.reader_title: Why EU-funded SME innovation networks win support
results.reader_what: EU funding success correlated with regional innovation strength, partner technological distance, and nonlinear organisational distance.
results.reader_why: The observed associations identify regional and network-design factors that matter for EU innovation-funding selection.

results.reader_title: Cross-border R&D partnerships and patent quality
results.reader_what: European joint-patent analysis associates cross-border collaboration with more highly cited patents and a U-shaped distance relationship.
results.reader_why: Partner distance and knowledge recombination can inform European cross-border collaboration and innovation-policy design.
results.reader_more: Using co-owned European Patent Office applications from 2000–2012, the paper tests patent quality against knowledge characteristics and geography. The author reports positive cross-country collaboration associations and a U-shaped relationship with physical distance. Alternative model specifications are reported, without establishing that distance causes outcomes.

deep_analysis.qualification: Joint patent applications at the European Patent Office in 2000–2012; patent citations are a proxy for quality, not causal proof.
